capabilities: import EPUB files into a managed per-book folder library
read books with paginated or scrolled modes and adjustable typography
annotate text with highlights, underlines, colors, notes, and tags
export chapters and annotations to managed-block Markdown
track reading time, progress, and estimated remaining time
extras: Fresh storage format: previously imported books, old reading data, exports and cover caches are not migrated, so EPUBs must be reimported. Concurrent edits to one book during file sync are not merged. Install instructions point to GitHub Releases rather than the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read EPUB books or turn their highlights and notes into vault Markdown.
summary: EPUB 2/3 reading workbench that imports books into a managed vault library with annotations, Markdown exports, reading statistics, and focus mode.
